controls_and_commands.source:
gcc -O2 -std=c11 -fno-builtin-memchr -fno-tree-vectorize -Wall -Wextra -pedantic memchr.c -o memchr-libc
gcc -O2 -std=c11 -fno-builtin-memchr -fno-tree-vectorize -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -DSCALAR memchr.c -o memchr-scalar

git archive HEAD | tar -x -C /tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/snapshot
cargo build --release --manifest-path /tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/snapshot/Cargo.toml --bin nacre --target-dir /tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/target-optimized

flock -x /tmp/nacre-option1-measure.lock bash -c '
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  taskset -c 0 perf stat -e cpu_core/cycles/,cpu_core/branches/,cpu_core/branch-misses/ -- /tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/dispatch-long-direct
  taskset -c 0 perf stat -e cpu_core/cycles/,cpu_core/branches/,cpu_core/branch-misses/ -- /tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/dispatch-long-virtual
done'

# baseline
gcc <native-flags> /tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/dispatch-long-direct.c \
  -o /tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/dispatch-long-fixed-base -lm -Wl,--gc-sections
# instrumented build, same source and eventual output identity
gcc <native-flags> -fprofile-generate=/tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/pgo-gcc-fixed \
  /tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/dispatch-long-direct.c \
  -o /tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/dispatch-long-fixed-pgo -lm -Wl,--gc-sections
# train
 taskset -c 0 /tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/dispatch-long-fixed-pgo
# use, same source and output identity
gcc <native-flags> -fprofile-use=/tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/pgo-gcc-fixed -fprofile-correction \
  /tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/dispatch-long-direct.c \
  -o /tmp/nacre-opt-evidence/dispatch-long-fixed-pgo -lm -Wl,--gc-sections

memchr.scope: C mechanism control for the libc primitive used by Nacre, not an end-to-end language speedup

dispatch.interpretation: Tiny measured difference only in the controlled monomorphic workload; not a broad application gain

pgo.interpretation: Branch-miss sign reverses across batches; no reproducible PGO improvement. Profile consumption confirmed with strace using stable generated C and executable paths.

cli_pgo.original_failure: Per-build temporary C paths caused profile-use ENOENT for training .gcda files.
cli_pgo.verification: Isolated staged CLI regression passed with GCC -Werror=missing-profile and executable-cache enabled; actual training/use executables both printed 49995011. Deleting training data causes profile-use failure rather than cache reuse.
